## Trigger

POST multipart/form-data to
/webhook/screenshot-bug-report

Called by the Vercel UI in
/ui_screenshotbugAIAgent, via its
serverless proxy (no CORS needed).

Parts: screenshot (file, required),
logs, steps, severity, environment.

## Actions

Groq vision drafts the report.
Model id lives in one field:
qwen/qwen3.8-27b is Preview,
swap it when Groq rotates.

Auth is a referenced credential,
never an embedded key.

## Results

Bug filed in VWO, screenshot
attached, and the ticket handed
back to the UI as JSON.

EDIT JIRA_BASE_URL at the top of
Normalize Intake so the returned
link points at your domain.
